world.title: US-China talks: Trade truce, AI, Iran, rare earths in focus ahead of Trump-Xi summit
world.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng are scheduled to meet in New York prior to the Trump-Xi summit on September 24. Key discussion topics will include trade relations, artificial intelligence, rare earth materials, and broader economic ties between the United States and China, aiming to address ongoing tensions and foster cooperation.

world.title: Petrol prices near Rs 400-mark in Pakistan: PTI Lawmakers ride donkey carts to Sindh Assembly
world.summary: Petrol prices in Pakistan have reached Rs 390.79 per litre, with high-speed diesel at Rs 424.92 per litre following a recent increase. In protest against these rising fuel costs, Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) lawmakers, led by Sajjad Ali Soomro, rode donkey carts to the Sindh Assembly. The demonstration highlights growing public discontent over the escalating prices of petroleum products.

world.title: Flames, huge plume of black smoke seen near Riyadh airport amid Houthi strikes
world.summary: Flames and a significant plume of black smoke were observed near King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Saturday, following reported strikes by Houthi forces. The incident has raised concerns about security and safety in the area. Authorities have not yet provided detailed information regarding the extent of the damage or any potential impact on airport operations.

business.title: 2026 TVS Ronin vs Royal Enfield Hunter 350: Price, Features and Engine Specs
business.summary: The 2026 TVS Ronin and Royal Enfield Hunter 350 are popular choices in India's budget-friendly cruiser segment. TVS recently launched the Ronin, which competes with the Hunter 350. A detailed comparison highlights differences in price, features, and engine specifications, catering to consumers looking for affordable yet stylish motorcycle options ahead of the upcoming Diwali festive season.

business.title: Defender" Interior Revealed Ahead Of Launch » MotorOctane
business.summary: The Mahindra Vision S-based SUV, referred to as the "Mini Defender," is generating significant anticipation ahead of its launch. Multiple prototypes have been spotted across India, indicating that the vehicle is nearing its release. Further details about the compact SUV continue to emerge, building excitement among potential buyers and automotive enthusiasts as the reveal date approaches.

business.title: Karunya KR-769 Result Today 19.09.2026; check winning numbers and prizes
business.summary: The Kerala Lottery Department announced the Karunya KR-769 lottery results for September 19, 2026. The draw took place at Gorky Bhavan in Thiruvananthapuram. The top prize winner will receive ₹1 crore. Live updates on winning numbers and additional prizes are available for participants. The event continues to attract significant public interest in the region.

technology.title: Fortnite Kingdom Hearts Power Hour (September 19, 2026): Start timings for all regions
technology.summary: Epic Games has announced the Kingdom Hearts Power Hours for Fortnite, scheduled for September 19, 2026. This event marks the ongoing crossover between the two franchises on the Fortnite island. Players can participate in various activities and challenges during these designated hours, enhancing their gaming experience. Specific start times for different regions will be provided closer to the event date.

technology.title: Schools adapt as Google releases Gemini; holiday e-commerce…
technology.summary: Google's Gemini chatbot is impacting schools, prompting adaptations in educational settings. Meanwhile, Deloitte predicts holiday e-commerce sales will reach $319 billion, indicating strong consumer spending. Additionally, PMMI reports that packaging robots can significantly reduce costs over time, highlighting the ongoing trend of integrating advanced technologies in business operations. These developments reflect the evolving landscape of B2B technology and innovation.

sports.title: 'Selection committee has made up its mind': Ex-India cricketer on Rishabh Pant's exclusion from West Indies ODIs
sports.summary: Former India cricketer Aakash Chopra stated that the Indian selection committee has decided on Rishabh Pant's immediate future in white-ball cricket. Pant was excluded from the ODI squad for the upcoming series against the West Indies, indicating a significant shift in his standing within the team. Chopra's comments reflect the selectors' current stance on Pant's performance and selection.

sports.title: Bangladesh announce squad for one-off Afghanistan Test
sports.summary: Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) has announced a 15-player squad for the one-off Test against Afghanistan, scheduled for 9 October 2026 in the United Arab Emirates. Najmul Hossain Shanto will continue as the Test captain. The squad includes players such as Tanzid Hasan and Shadman Islam, marking an important match for both teams in the cricket calendar.

sports.title: Mohun Bagan wins Calcutta Football League after eight years, beats Mohammedan SC 3-2
sports.summary: Mohun Bagan Super Giant won the Calcutta Football League title after defeating Mohammedan Sporting 3-2 in a dramatic match at Barasat Stadium. Mohammedan equalised twice, but Sayan Banerjee, a substitute, scored the decisive goal for Mohun Bagan. This victory marks Mohun Bagan's first CFL title in eight years, concluding the league's final matchday on Saturday.

health.title: Irregular periods, acne and hair thinning? Doctor shares 5 signs of PMOS and explains when to get tested
health.summary: Irregular periods, acne, and hair thinning can indicate Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS), according to a medical expert. Subtle changes, like increased hair loss or sudden breakouts, may not seem concerning but can signal underlying issues when they occur together. It is advised to consult a doctor if these symptoms persist or worsen, as early diagnosis is crucial.

health.title: Consuming extra vitamin D is less good than it sounds
health.summary: A recent study suggests that taking extra vitamin D supplements may not provide the expected health benefits. While vitamin D is essential for health and primarily obtained through sunlight exposure, the effectiveness of supplementation in improving health outcomes appears limited. This finding raises questions about the reliance on supplements, particularly during shorter daylight months when natural vitamin D production decreases.

health.title: The 5 best dinner options for your gut health
health.summary: Experts highlight five dinner options that promote gut health and improve sleep quality. These meals can enhance digestion, which is closely linked to restful sleep. Key factors for optimal sleep include room temperature and dietary choices. By focusing on gut-friendly foods, individuals can potentially improve their overall well-being and ensure a more restorative night’s rest.

science.title: In 2018, NASA cooled rubidium atoms to near absolute zero aboard the ISS; creating the fifth state of matter in orbit
science.summary: In 2018, NASA's Cold Atom Lab aboard the International Space Station successfully cooled rubidium atoms to near absolute zero, creating Bose-Einstein condensates. This achievement marked a significant milestone in quantum physics, demonstrating the formation of the fifth state of matter in microgravity. The experiment enhances understanding of atomic behavior and contributes to advancements in scientific research related to quantum mechanics.

science.title: This strange world has no star to orbit, yet James Webb has revealed its changing weather from 20 light-years away
science.summary: The James Webb Space Telescope observed SIMP 0136, a brown dwarf located twenty light-years away, revealing its changing weather patterns. Researchers identified that variations in temperature and cloud structure account for the atmospheric changes. The brown dwarf displays three recurring weather states as it rotates, offering a new method to study distant celestial bodies with limited direct observation capabilities.

entertainment.title: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ team meets Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis at Varsha bungalow, seeks Ganpati Bappa’s blessings amid Rs 300 crore global run – WATCH VIDEO
entertainment.summary: The team of the devotional drama 'Hanuman Ansh', inspired by Neem Karoli Baba's spiritual journey, met Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis at Varsha bungalow. They sought blessings from Ganpati Bappa as the film continues its successful global run, reportedly grossing Rs 300 crore. The film has been recognized as one of the year's unexpected successes in cinema.

entertainment.title: Vijay Sethupathi says this about CM Vijay after claims of shading him on Bigg Boss Tamil 10; calls Jason Sanjay ‘cute’
entertainment.summary: At the audio launch of his film Baththa, Vijay Sethupathi addressed claims of shading CM Vijay on Bigg Boss Tamil 10, clarifying his stance. He also referred to CM Vijay's son, Jason Sanjay, as "cute." Sethupathi's comments aimed to dispel any misunderstandings regarding his relationship with the CM and his family during the event.

entertainment.title: Atlee reveals CM Vijay's advice after SRK approached him for Jawan
entertainment.summary: Filmmaker Atlee revealed that Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay advised him to accept the offer for the film Jawan when Shah Rukh Khan approached him. Atlee credited this advice as a pivotal moment in his career, highlighting Vijay's ongoing support. He shared these insights during the audio launch of Vijay Sethupathi’s film Baththa in Chennai.
